elements.name: Validate that the user can search for any product and place an order from the 'Categories'.

steps.name: the user is on the homepage
the user should see the Categories section
the user search any product in "Search by product name" field
the product should be displayed in the search result
the user click on the product from the search result
the product details should be displayed
user selects more than one quantity
the user click on the Save to Wishlist button
the user click on the 'Add to cart' button
the product should be added to the cart
verify the cart summary is displayed
